CompetitionEntry.title: CompetitionEntry
CompetitionEntry.description: An official in-app marked nationwide competition submission with learner name, school, province, grade, and score.

uid.description: Authenticated learner UID who submitted the entry.

learnerName.description: Learner full name recorded on the nationwide leaderboard.

schoolName.description: School name recorded for the learner and top schools table.

province.description: Zambian province of the learner's school.

competitionId.description: Identifier of the nationwide competition test.

competitionTitle.description: Display title of the nationwide competition test.

maxScore.description: Maximum possible marks on the competition test.

timeTakenSeconds.description: Time taken by the learner to complete the test in seconds.

questionsCorrect.description: Number of questions answered with full or partial pass marks.

questionsTotal.description: Total number of questions in the competition.

markedSummary.description: Concise in-app examiner summary for the submission.

status.description: Publication status of the marked leaderboard entry.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the marked submission was recorded.

/competition_entries/{entryId}.description: Nationwide competition scores with learner names and schools.
